name: alibaba-rfq-midscene
description: Control logged-in Alibaba RFQ pages through Midscene.js, analyze requests with the local Claude/GLM agent, and enforce deterministic quote policy.

interface.shortDescription: Scan, analyze and safely quote Alibaba RFQs through your logged-in Chrome.
interface.longDescription: Uses Midscene.js Chrome Bridge to control the user's existing logged-in browser, local Claude/GLM for specification extraction and copy, and deterministic policy gates for pricing and submission.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my logged-in Chrome to scan Alibaba RFQs, analyze suitable requests, and prepare guarded quotes. Do not submit without immediate confirmation.
